### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory containing taxprofiler pipeline output (multiqc/, taxpasta/, one directory per profiler) |
| `SAMPLESHEET_FILE` | — | Path to the taxprofiler samplesheet (sample, run_accession, instrument_platform, fastq_1, fastq_2, fasta). Auto-detected from {DATA_ROOT}/input/ when omitted; supplies the sample ids and the sequencing platform the profiles are annotated with. |

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`melon/ranks.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/melon/ranks.py) | Melon genome-copy estimates, one row per full seven-rank lineage. | `superkingdom`, `phylum`, `class`, `order`, `family`, `genus`, `species`, `copy_number`, `abundance`, `identity_mean`, `lineages` |
| [`nf-core/taxprofiler/taxon_names.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/taxprofiler/recipes/taxon_names.py) | taxonomy_id -> (name, rank) harvested from the profilers' own report files. | `taxonomy_id`, `name`, `rank` |
| [`sylph/ani.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/sylph/ani.py) | sylph per-genome containment: ANI against abundance and coverage. | `sample`, `genome`, `contig_name`, `taxonomic_abundance`, `abundance_frac`, `sequence_abundance`, `adjusted_ani`, `naive_ani`, `eff_cov`, `median_cov`, `containment_frac`, `kmers_reassigned` |
| [`sylph/profile.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/sylph/profile.py) | sylph-tax merged profile -> long sample x rank x taxon composition. | `sample_id`, `clade_name`, `taxon`, `rank`, `abundance` |
| [`taxpasta/embedding.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/taxpasta/embedding.py) | Bray-Curtis PCoA over every profiling run in the taxpasta collection. | `sample_id`, `dim_1`, `dim_2`, `sample`, `profiler`, `database`, `profiler_db`, `platform` |
| [`taxpasta/matrix.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/taxpasta/matrix.py) | Taxon x (sample, profiler) relative-abundance matrix for the clustered heatmap. | `taxon`, `rank` |
| [`taxpasta/presence.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/taxpasta/presence.py) | Which profilers detected which taxon, as an UpSet membership matrix. | `sample`, `taxonomy_id`, `taxon`, `rank`, `n_profilers` |
| [`taxpasta/profiles.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/taxpasta/profiles.py) | taxpasta standardised profiles -> one long cross-profiler abundance table. | `profiler`, `database`, `profiler_db`, `sample`, `platform`, `taxonomy_id`, `name`, `rank`, `count`, `rel_abundance` |
| [`taxpasta/sample_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/taxpasta/sample_summary.py) | One row per profiling run: how much each profiler found, and how evenly. | `sample`, `profiler`, `database`, `profiler_db`, `platform`, `taxa_observed`, `assigned_count`, `top_taxon`, `top_taxon_fraction`, `shannon`, `evenness` |
